tips.text: Join or get invited to a clan whose Tenno Lab already has Banshee researched, buy the four blueprints, then leave; they stay yours.
Expect it to be easy: the pain is only for brand-new clans researching from nothing, and even they are told to join a clan.
Research the main Banshee blueprint first if you use your own clan; the three part researches stay locked until it is done.
Build the three parts before the main Banshee; buying a part's blueprint is not building it.
Grab Fieldron, Detonite Injector and Mutagen Mass from Invasions and containers whenever they appear if you research solo; they cannot be traded.
Demolish the lab if you need the room back; the research is kept and the list stays unlocked when you rebuild it.
